error: decisive_spans must contain exact vignette offsets

decisive_spans.text: pronounced head and neck flexion, particularly noticeable in the standing position

response.rationale: The vignette explicitly states "pronounced head and neck flexion, particularly noticeable in the standing position," which is a hallmark symptom of Camptocormia. While other conditions mention head and neck flexion, the emphasis on the standing position strongly points to Camptocormia. Cervical spondylotic myelopathy is a plausible runner-up due to neck pain, difficulty with forward gaze, and gait disturbance, but the specific description of the flexion is more indicative of Camptocormia.
